summary: Strong test suite with comprehensive unit tests, workflow validation, and real end-to-end testing via `act`. Covers all core requirements (version parsing, commit classification, version bumping, changelog generation, file I/O, workflow structure). Well-organized into three logical test modules with clear separation of concerns. Tests are isolated, use proper fixtures, and include explicit assertions on exact expected values. Primary gaps: limited edge case coverage (corrupted files, malformed commits, unusual scopes), no direct CLI argument testing (--date, --version-file), and some complex scenarios like changelog prepending to existing files. The shared `act-result.txt` file could theoretically cause issues if tests run in parallel. Would reliably catch most regressions in core functionality and workflow behavior, but some exotic scenarios lack coverage.
